milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining smooth_sandstone with a pickaxe drops the smooth_sandstone block as an item into the player's inventory. The player must mine at least 1 block from the barrier wall to break through. inventory_has is preferred over mine_block event because the item physically entering inventory is the most reliable signal, and smooth_sandstone is not in the player's starting inventory (only a stone_pickaxe is given).

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone_stairs at the crafting table produces the item directly into the player's inventory. The standard recipe uses 6 sandstone in a stair pattern to yield 4 sandstone_stairs. min_count=4 matches exactly one craft operation. sandstone_stairs are not in the starting inventory nor obtainable from any other source in this scene, so inventory_has is the cleanest and most reliable check.
